name: Flooded Greater Frostflow · Cold ×2
primary:
A zone at the aim point with a 6.23-block radius for 21 s. Every second, on everyone inside except you:
• Soaked for 21 s
• Knockback
• Cold 72: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Cold 80: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Slowness III for 9 s
self_description:
On you:
• Soaked for 21 s and leaves a puddle
• Knockback
• Cold 72: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Cold 25: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
